holidays.name: Makar Sankranti
holidays.description_en: Solar festival marking the sun's entry into Capricorn, celebrated with sesame sweets, kite flying, and holy dips.

holidays.name: Vasant Panchami
holidays.description_en: Festival welcoming spring and honoring Saraswati, goddess of learning, wisdom, and the arts.

holidays.name: Maha Shivaratri
holidays.description_en: The great night of Shiva, observed with fasting, night-long vigil, and meditation.

holidays.name: Holi
holidays.description_en: Festival of colours marking the arrival of spring and the triumph of good over evil.

holidays.name: Ram Navami
holidays.description_en: Celebrates the birth of Rama, the seventh avatar of Vishnu.

holidays.name: Hanuman Jayanti
holidays.description_en: Celebrates the birth of Hanuman, the devoted servant of Rama, known for strength, courage, and selfless service.

holidays.name: Akshaya Tritiya
holidays.description_en: An auspicious day whose name means inexhaustible, observed with charity, new beginnings, and prayers.

holidays.name: Rath Yatra
holidays.description_en: Festival of the chariot celebrating Lord Jagannath's journey, observed with grand processions and devotion.

holidays.name: Guru Purnima
holidays.description_en: Full moon of Ashadha dedicated to honoring one's spiritual teacher, observed since ancient times by students of Vedic learning.

holidays.name: Raksha Bandhan
holidays.description_en: Celebrates the bond of protection between siblings; sisters tie a rakhi on their brothers' wrists as a symbol of love and care.

holidays.name: Janmashtami
holidays.description_en: Celebrates the birth of Krishna, eighth avatar of Vishnu.

holidays.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
holidays.description_en: Marks the arrival of Ganesha, observed with home and community puja for ten days.

holidays.name: Sharada Navratri
holidays.description_en: Nine nights of devotion to the Divine Mother, culminating in Dussehra.

holidays.name: Dussehra
holidays.description_en: Celebrates the victory of Rama over Ravana, marking the triumph of righteousness over evil at the close of Navratri.

holidays.name: Diwali
holidays.description_en: Festival of lights celebrating the return of Rama to Ayodhya and the triumph of light over darkness.

holidays.name: Kartik Purnima
holidays.description_en: The full moon of Kartik, auspicious for holy bathing and lamp-lighting, celebrated as Dev Deepawali on the Ganga ghats.
